While the gate is open (hunt at your own pace)

Random mini world change: near one of Tibia's big cities a {wiki:Fury Gate|Fury Gate} opens, a fire portal that leads to a {wiki:Fury Dungeon|dungeon} full of fire creatures, including {creature:Fury|Furies}, {creature:Hellhound|Hellhounds} and {creature:Furyosa}. Find out which city it opened in, enter through the gate and hunt inside.
One of the 10 possible locations (example: Thais)
**Promoted** character: the {wiki:Fury Gate|Fury Gate} only teleports promoted Premium players of level 60 or higher.
The mini world change has to be active on your server that day.
Hunting supplies (potions, runes); fire protection helps a lot
Access to the Fury Dungeon while the gate is open (experience and loot from the creatures)
The gate only appears in one city at a time. Read the server messages when you log in and go and check the locations in the table.
The creatures in there are almost all fire creatures: equip fire protection.
1. Find out whether the world change is active

When this mini world change is active, you see one of these messages: *“A fiery fury gate has opened near one of the major cities somewhere in Tibia.”* or *“Hear ye! Hear ye! A fiery gate has opened, threatening a city! Guard the people frightened, their death would be a pity!”*
Looking for the gate in the cities

The {wiki:Fury Gate|Fury Gate} can appear just outside the limits of any of these cities. Travel to the city (boat, carpet or on foot), leave by the side indicated in the table and go to the coordinates. Check the locations until you find the open gate.
Going through the gate and hunting

Enter the Fury Gate. It takes you to a {wiki:Fury Dungeon|dungeon} completely full of fire creatures: {creature:Massive Fire Elemental|Massive Fire Elementals}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}, {creature:Dragonling|Dragonlings}, {creature:Diabolic Imp|Diabolic Imps}, {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters}, {creature:Infernalist|Infernalists}, {creature:Fury|Furies}, {creature:Hellhound|Hellhounds} and {creature:Furyosa}.
There are very dangerous creatures like Hellhounds and Furies: do not go in below the recommended level without a team.

The {wiki:Fury Dungeon|Fury Dungeon} is deep beneath **Edron** ({coord:33303,31829,14}), whichever city the Fury Gate opened in. The wiki does not describe an exit of the dungeon's own: to leave, go back the **same way** to the point where the Fury Gate dropped you. Keep supplies for the return trip.
It is a mini world change: it appears randomly on some days and in only one city at a time.
